title: Nutritious Dutch Noodle Dish
description: A resinous and fluffy Dutch noodle dish made with brown rice noodles, featuring a cure for hangovers and Buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients, this dish is perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the brown rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until the onion is translucent.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the mushroom mixture.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the noodles and stir to combine.
Season the noodles with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the noodles to a serving dish and garnish with chopped scallions.
Serve the noodles hot and enjoy.
